grounding.states: A consistent wind-down routine, a dim quiet room, and catching sleepy signs before he gets overtired help nap timing at most ages

value.answer: It depends a bit on his age, but a few things help at pretty much any age: keep the same wind-down routine every time, dim the lights and keep the room quiet, and watch for sleepy signs so you start before he gets overtired, since an overtired kid often fights sleep harder. How old is he?
